examples:
<sqf>
// create IGUI display
// such display can be closed with closeDisplay command or by overwriting the same cut layer with another output.
// note that "Unload" EH for some reason does not work with such display.
"someLayer" cutRsc ["RscTitleDisplayEmpty", "PLAIN"];
private _display = uiNamespace getVariable "RscTitleDisplayEmpty";
</sqf>
name: cutRsc

Item.desc: the class name of the resource. ("Default" will remove the current resource.)
Item.name: class

Item.desc: one of "PLAIN", "PLAIN DOWN", "BLACK", "BLACK FADED", "BLACK OUT", "BLACK IN", "WHITE OUT" and "WHITE IN". See [[Title Effect Type]]s for more information about these values.
Item.name: effect

Item.desc: time in seconds to fade in resource.
Item.name: speed

Item.desc: [[false]] to hide the text when the map is opened.
Item.name: showInMap

Item.desc: [[false]] to show the resource under in-game HUD (for example, a binocular effect)
Item.name: drawOverHUD

Item.desc:
or [[String]]
* [[Number]] - layer number on which the effect is shown, where 0 is the back most. Layer number is rounded to the nearest integer and also cannot be negative. Layer 99.5 will be treated as layer 100
* [[String]] - {{GVI|arma3|1.58|size= 0.75}} layer name on which the effect is shown. Layer names are CaSe SeNsItIvE.
Item.name: layer
